s.how: Mix 150g grated parmesan with chopped thyme. Spoon small rounds onto a lined tray and flatten into coins. Bake at 190C for 6 minutes until golden and lacy, then cool on the tray. Serve stacked like coins with fig jam and a wedge of brie.

Warm 16 blinis in a low oven for 5 minutes. Top each with a small spoon of creme fraiche, a little salmon roe and a few snipped chives. Add a tiny squeeze of lemon and lay them out in neat rows on silver trays like a proper mansion party.

m.note: the burger counter built right into his house
m.how: Roll 600g beef mince into 4 balls and smash flat on a very hot pan. Season, flip after 2 minutes and add American cheese. Mix mayonnaise with chopped pickles for special sauce. Build on toasted buns with onion and pickles and serve with oven fries.

w.note: the family vault at Mount Richmore
w.how: Melt 150g sugar to amber, then whisk in 150ml cream and a pinch of salt for caramel sauce. Scoop vanilla ice cream into tall glasses, pour over the caramel and scatter with crushed honeycomb. Top each sundae with a gold chocolate coin.

d.note: playing baseball with real kids at last
d.how: Blend 4 big scoops of vanilla ice cream with 500ml cold milk and 4 tbsp malted milk powder until thick and smooth. Pour into tall chilled glasses, add a straw to each and serve straight away while still frothy on top.
